head: bd4660d9602f30deab9909d2e66499614f8fb38e
scope: Original exact acceptance criteria72,73,77,80; read-only source/proof audit. No source edits, routing/build jobs, commits or tracker writes.
overall: 73performance pending; whole-goal completion not asserted. Full smoke handle96123reported live by primary; its overall result was not inferred from partial progress.

criteria.requirement: Valid gr_text containing '((', ')', escaped quotes, escaped backslashes and embedded '(gr_text' terminates and round-trips correctly on copper and non-copper layers.
criteria.finding: 24 payload/layer/writer subcases retain literal text exactly, including escaped quotes/backslashes and fake gr_text tokens.

criteria.requirement: Tests exercise both add_tracks_to_pcb and add_tracks_and_vias_to_pcb with those inputs.
criteria.finding: Both public writers are exercised on F.Cu, B.Cu and F.SilkS.

criteria.requirement: Truncated or malformed blocks raise a useful error instead of hanging or rewriting the rest of the board.
criteria.finding: Unterminated string/block and stray closing parenthesis raise ValueError; no output board is written.

criteria.requirement: A small native KiCad fixture with literal-parenthesis text routes or returns a normal graded failure within budget, without text loss.
criteria.finding: Native F.Cu (( / B.Cu ) fixture completed with PASS preservation/validation. Routing command duration3.466s under60s; no budget/stall/kill stop; text values retained.

criteria.requirement: Boards with F.Cu/B.Cu text and net-less board graphics retain those objects and pass copper_graphics preservation after routing.
criteria.finding: Native candidate retains F/B text plus netless filled board rectangles; copper_graphics preservation PASS.

criteria.requirement: New routes respect native clearances to retained copper; tests include a narrow passage affected by the artwork.
criteria.finding: Retained rectangles/text constrict a passage. Native DRC reports0new violations and COMPLETE routing; source tree hash unchanged.

criteria.requirement: Net-tied graphics and functional footprint copper retain their existing protection.
criteria.finding: Fixture includes /GUARD net-tagged board rectangle and pad-bearing J1 copper tab. Native test asserts nonempty guard copper, exact native before/after footprint shape layer/type/width/fill/global geometry, native clearance and preservation.

criteria.requirement: Unsupported shapes produce an explicit preflight limitation/refusal without moving them or relaxing DRC.
criteria.finding: Unsupported copper curve test returns explicit preflight limitation without source mutation; direct text parsing refuses absent/stale native bounds. Router escalation remains off and native DRC is retained.

criteria.requirement: Existing simple-board completion and the owner's 10 percent runtime/memory limits are rechecked for this semantic engine change.
criteria.finding: Simple fixture correctness has retained native evidence, but the owner1.10 runtime/memory comparison is not qualified. Primary reports stable benchmark handle21209live; this audit did not restart or poll that handle.

material_gaps: Owner1.10runtime and aggregate-memory qualification remains pending stable benchmark.

criteria.requirement: With a reproducible installed build, budget_reached, stalled or killed in any relevant command makes the current result measurement=false.
criteria.finding: Budget/stall/kill flags at multiple command positions disqualify current measurement despite positive installed-build repeat evidence; process-level flags are included by source.

criteria.requirement: A graceful stop may still produce a valid/incomplete candidate; its process/routing/validation meanings are unchanged.
criteria.finding: Real native candidates are routed/reaped before timing metadata injection. Single-budget and intermediate pair-stall runs keep process PASS/routing COMPLETE/validation PASS/candidate bytes and measurement false; revalidation preserves the distinction. Both cases passed current smoke log lines50-51.

criteria.requirement: Normal unstopped deterministic runs retain the existing positive qualification; Freerouting remains an attempt.
criteria.finding: Unstopped positively qualified build remains measurement true; Freerouting remains false.

criteria.requirement: Single-ended and multi-pass differential routing, revalidation and schemas document/test the distinction.
criteria.finding: Native test covers real single pass, pair pass stopped before an unstopped single-ended tail, both schema versions, and validate_record. The v2 schema permits additional process fields; v1 explicitly types the optional qualification field. Central interface docs define both record versions; optional description-only v2 clarification is supplied separately, not a compatibility defect.

criteria.requirement: Add/remove/merge/overlap sequences assert bitmap and authoritative blocked-cell membership agree, including growth and overflow windows.
criteria.finding: Independent Counter oracle checks public bitmap membership after duplicate add, batch add/remove, merge, overlap and final removal, with left/up/right/down growth and million-cell capped-window overflow. Static/clone/layer cases supplement membership protection.

criteria.requirement: Search cases assert obstacle avoidance, permitted layers, deterministic tie ordering, empty/no-path cases and pair heading/via constraints against a small independent oracle or retained reference.
criteria.finding: Independent finite unit-cost Dijkstra compares exact lane/pair paths, deterministic ties, blocked cells, allowed layer1 versus free layer0, empty/no-path, pair heading/turn debt and required via stages. Weighted-search/crossover equivalence remains explicitly outside the fast gate.

criteria.requirement: Tests run against the owned extension/source without vendor/krt or network acquisition.
criteria.finding: Cargo builds owned source with --locked --offline; loader imports the just-built library by absolute path. Kernel/parity/writer tests require numeric runtime only; no vendor/krt or network acquisition at execution.

criteria.requirement: A documented fast command fails on deliberate invariant-breaking mutants; native KiCad integration remains a separate required gate.
criteria.finding: make kernel passed6kernel tests+3writer tests+retained upstream parity. Three separately compiled mutations (stale bitmap clear, reversed lane tie ordering, ignored pair-via clearance) each failed an assertion; compile/import failures do not count. Native make smoke remains a separate required gate.

criteria.requirement: Inventory retained, replaced and excluded upstream tests with reasons; do not count unrelated tool-registry failures as routing coverage.
criteria.finding: Inventory pins upstream295f9ee..., retains one byte-identical obstacle parity entrypoint, lists973excluded fast-gate entrypoints with hashes/imports/reasons, names new tests and the two retained native regressions, and explicitly declines full-route churn/weighted-search/GUI/registry coverage. No upstream tests claimed replaced one-for-one; new bounded oracle protection is distinguished from excluded churn.
